900.3.10(937).explanation: Exception RD 937 sets a 9.0 m front setback, 1.2 m side setback, 4.5 m street side setback and a 0.3 m garage side setback, keeps the lot frontage and area that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, caps gross floor area at 198.0 square metres at 2651 Kennedy Rd., and allows a software office in a detached house that existed in 1988 at 2697 Kennedy Rd.

900.3.10(588).explanation: Exception RD 588 keeps the lot frontage and area that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, sets a 1.0 m side setback on one side only with no encroachment, a 3.0 m setback from a street lot line, 50% maximum lot coverage, a 6.0 m garage entrance setback where it faces the street, and requires the parking space to be in a building.

900.3.10(1427).explanation: Exception RD 1427 requires additions above the first storey of a lawfully existing detached house to meet the minimum setbacks, bars platforms higher than the first floor from encroaching into the required front or rear yard, and preserves section 12(2) 107 of former By-law 438-86.
